title: Tech & architecture slides for the Metsä Group deck

slides.title: Forecasts run on your Azure Databricks and SAP feeds, with a proven library rather than bespoke algorithms
bullets: SAP S/4HANA demand, stock and production data feed Databricks, which runs established open-source forecasting methods. Planners see forecasts and inventory recommendations in your BI tool.
Anomalies such as kiln incidents are flagged for planners, not modelled one by one.

diagram.band: Pilot first: one product line, two hubs. Scale only when forecast error beats the current plan

slides.title: Buy before build: we check commercial packages first and say which wins
table: Commercial planning package (e.g. SAP's planning suite)
You already license it, or planners need its workflows
Fits your stack, no new licence, low upkeep
Only for a gap the others cannot cover
slides.note: Technical unknowns: data history depth per product line, hub master data quality, existing planning licences. The effort and price come from our own calculation, not from published figures.
